value.rationale: Pairwise co-block correlations and full positive association encode mathematically distinct dependence properties. The three-label transitive triangle is the minimal natural configuration where these diverge. The exact necessary-and-sufficient boundary classifies every increasing test and changes sharply across canonical Bell, Ewens and Pitman–Yor partitions. The strict positive correlation theorem for all principal Bell coalescence events provides an additional substantive contrast useful for interpreting random-equivalence-relation models.
